classification.difficultyReason: Explain why an odd number of equally spaced seats cannot provide a directly opposite seat.

content.prompt: Explain why there are zero ways to seat Bob and Mary directly opposite each other in a circular arrangement if there are an odd number of people (including them)?

answer.short: Directly opposite seats require equal numbers of people between Bob and Mary on each side. An odd total makes this impossible.
answer.worked: If Bob and Mary were directly opposite, there would be the same number of people between them on each side. For an odd total $n$, the remaining $n-2$ people are odd in number, so they cannot be split into two equal groups. Hence there are zero such arrangements.
